why_manual: Every column is headed with a synonym no reasonable vocabulary would list - the id column is 'Marker', the options column 'Permitted replies'. The automated extractor declines to classify the table rather than guessing, so ground truth was read by a person from the document. Three rows, one table, transcribed field by field.
